tasks.command: & { $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $env:JAVA_HOME='C:\Program Files\Android\Android Studio\jbr'; $env:ANDROID_HOME=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Android\sdk'; $env:ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=$env:ANDROID_HOME; $adb=Join-Path $env:ANDROID_HOME 'platform-tools\adb.exe'; $serial='emulator-5582'; $avd='community_membership_20260923'; $name=@(& $adb -s $serial emu avd name | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ -ne 'OK' -and $_ -ne '' }); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $name.Count -ne 1 -or $name[0] -ne $avd) { throw 'Unexpected test emulator' }; $owned=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^qemu-system-x86_64(-headless)?\.exe$' -and $_.CommandLine -match ('-avd\s+' + [regex]::Escape($avd) + '\b') -and $_.CommandLine -match '-read-only' -and $_.CommandLine -match '-no-snapshot-save' -and $_.CommandLine -match '-port\s+5582\b' }); if ($owned.Count -ne 1) { throw 'A single read-only test emulator on port 5582 is required' }; $boot=(& $adb -s $serial shell getprop sys.boot_completed | Out-String).Trim(); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $boot -ne '1') { throw 'Emulator has not completed boot' }; & $adb -s $serial shell cmd connectivity airplane-mode enable; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Cannot enable guest airplane mode' }; & $adb -s $serial shell svc wifi disable; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Cannot disable test Wi-Fi' }; & $adb -s $serial shell svc data disable; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Cannot disable test mobile data' }; & $adb -s $serial shell settings put global mobile_data 0; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Cannot turn off the mobile data setting' }; $wifi=(& $adb -s $serial shell cmd wifi status | Out-String).Trim(); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $wifi -notmatch 'Wifi is disabled') { throw 'Wi-Fi is not confirmed disabled' }; $mobile=(& $adb -s $serial shell settings get global mobile_data | Out-String).Trim(); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $mobile -ne '0') { throw 'Mobile data is not confirmed disabled' }; & $adb -s $serial shell wm size 640x1280; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Cannot set the 320 dp fixture viewport' }; & $adb -s $serial shell wm density 320; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Cannot set fixture density' }; $fontBefore=(& $adb -s $serial shell settings get system font_scale | Out-String).Trim(); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Cannot read original font scale' }; & .\android\gradlew.bat -p android :app:assembleDebug :app:assembleDebugAndroidTest --offline --console=plain; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Native test build failed' }; & $adb -s $serial install -r --no-incremental .\android\app\build\outputs\apk\debug\app-debug.apk; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Debug update failed' }; & $adb -s $serial install -r --no-incremental .\android\app\build\outputs\apk\androidTest\debug\app-debug-androidTest.apk; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Test update failed' }; $result=@(& $adb -s $serial shell am instrument -w -r -e community_disposable_ui_fixture true -e class com.community.platform.feature.spaces.SpaceScreenTest com.community.platform.debug.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner); $instrumentExit=$LASTEXITCODE; $result | Tee-Object -FilePath .\.local\ownership-native-offline-5582.txt; $fontAfter=(& $adb -s $serial shell settings get system font_scale | Out-String).Trim(); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $fontAfter -ne $fontBefore) { throw 'Original font-scale setting was not restored' }; $passes=@($result | Where-Object { $_ -match '^INSTRUMENTATION_STATUS_CODE: 0\s*$' }).Count; if ($instrumentExit -ne 0 -or $passes -ne 17 -or -not ($result -match '^OK \(17 tests\)\s*$') -or ($result -match '^INSTRUMENTATION_STATUS_CODE: -')) { throw 'Offline Space screen tests did not pass 17/17 without skips' }; Write-Output ('PASS: seventeen offline Space tests; measured 320 dp / 200% dialog; font scale restored to ' + $fontAfter) }
